lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:0.title: Judas Swing guard works.
lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:0.detail: Entering at 02:00 during London Open manipulation = trap confirmed. Guard prevented -1R.

lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:1.title: 1m Inversion can fade fast.
lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:1.detail: 7/8 at 02:00 → 2/8 at 03:00 → 0/8 at 03:26. Re-validate at entry time, not signal time.

lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:2.title: SB displacement must occur during SB window.
lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:2.detail: The move already happened during Judas. By SB time, displacement was gone.

lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:3.title: The forecast should run BEFORE every signal.
lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:3.detail: 5m forecast at 02:00 would have shown the bounce projection and prevented premature entries.

lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:4.title: The reload is cleaner than the original signal.
lesson:gbpusd:2026-07-27:4.detail: The bounce exhausted, the 5m flipped, and now all TFs can align with the HTF direction.
